items.name: Eggshell Charm
items.lore: A brewing eggshell, cracked and bound in silver wire. It made a changeling laugh once.

items.name: Blackthorn Ring
items.lore: A ring of blackthorn wood, hard as iron, thorns turned inward. It doesn't prick. Usually.

items.name: Cradle-Song Sash
items.lore: Embroidered with the words of a Hibernian lullaby, and something under the words, in faerie script.

items.name: Fae-Milk Mantle
items.lore: Soft as a baby's blanket. It belonged to a faerie child, for a little while.

items.name: Sealskin Cloak
items.lore: Grey and silver, softer than any wool. It smells of the sea and it always will.

items.name: Roane-Pearl Pendant
items.lore: A grey pearl from deep water, the kind the roane give as wedding-gifts.

items.name: Fergal's Net-Knot Bracer
items.lore: A fisherman's bracer, knotted the way only Fergal knots.

items.name: Skinner's Ring
items.lore: Taken from a dergan who skinned the roane for their pelts. Scrub it as you like.

items.name: Mended-Elbow Bracer
items.lore: Cut from the sleeve of a blue coat. Mandra mended that elbow four times.

items.name: Mother's Worry-Stone
items.lore: Worn smooth by a thumb, over a great many nights.

items.name: Gang-Colour Sash
items.lore: Blue and grey, the villainous youths' colours. Dallan wore it inside out the day he came home.

items.name: Lambing-Night Ring
items.lore: A shepherd's ring, given to whoever sat up all night with the ewes.

items.name: Spy's Pebble
items.lore: Dallan's signal: a white pebble on the gatepost meant 'I'm safe'.

items.name: Paymaster's Signet
items.lore: A plain ring of dark iron, the red hand scraped off it. The weight is still good.

items.name: Lieutenant's Bandolier
items.lore: Corr's, with a dozen little pockets, every one of them empty now.

items.name: Ringleader's Knuckle-Ring
items.lore: Heavy, ugly and effective, like its last owner.

items.name: South-Camp Cloak
items.lore: The ringleader's own cloak, patched with the colours of every gang he broke to make his.

items.name: White-Pebble Pendant
items.lore: One of Dallan's white pebbles, bored through and strung. 'I'm safe.'

items.name: Balm-Tin Charm
items.lore: Nessa's old balm tin. It still smells of mudman and mint.

items.name: Rat-Tail Lace
items.lore: Don't ask what the lace is made of.

items.name: Woad-Blue Gloves Charm
items.lore: Rhian's dyeing gloves, shrunk to a charm. Still blue. Always blue.

items.name: Three-Pot Belt
items.lore: Hooks for three dye-pots: blue, yellow and red.

items.name: Ditch-Spade Bracer
items.lore: Beaten from the blade of a curmudgeon's ditch-spade.

items.name: Spring-Water Phial
items.lore: Filled at the spring the morning it ran full again.

items.name: Bigfist Gauntlet-Charm
items.lore: A spraggon's knuckle-guard, far too big for any spraggon.

items.name: Hill King's Crown-Ring
items.lore: Grubb's pebble crown, the best pebble kept.

items.name: Truce-Keeper's Cloak
items.lore: Rhian dyed it three colours, so nobody on the hill could call it theirs.

items.name: Lily-Dew Phial
items.lore: Never empty, never quite full. Smells of white lilies.

items.name: Thief's Petal Charm
items.lore: A petal from a mere sprite. It curls away from your fingers.

items.name: Go-Between's Scale
items.lore: Sabha shed it on purpose. You're nearly sure of that.

items.name: Trout-Leather Bracer
items.lore: Supple, silver and faintly fishy.

items.name: Old Drumhead Charm
items.lore: The split drumhead, cut round and bound in brass. It hums when it's struck.

items.name: Midsummer Sash
items.lore: Tavie wore it every midsummer for twenty years.

items.name: Cured-Hide Bracer
items.lore: Curmudgeon-cured. Stinks for a month, lasts a hundred years.

items.name: Meadowsweet Mantle
items.lore: Embroidered with foxglove and meadowsweet, for the bees.

items.name: Drowned-Lily Circlet Charm
items.lore: A lily from the bottom of a silent mere. It never opens.

items.name: Herbwife's Satchel-Belt
items.lore: Orlaith's own. A pocket for everything, and one for dew.

items.name: Mere-Guard Bracer
items.lore: Pale as bone and cold as deep water.

items.name: Reeve's Tally-Stick Charm
items.lore: Notched for every sack. The last notch is yours.

items.name: Clay-Caked Bracer
items.lore: The clay won't come off. Cathbad says it's lucky.

items.name: Watchman's Studded Belt
items.lore: Studded with mudman chert. Kylirean is very proud of it.

items.name: Cadger-Skin Bracer
items.lore: Wolf-skin, the fur turned in. Warm on a night watch.

items.name: Tharl's Trap-Chain Charm
items.lore: A link from Tharl's trap-chain. It still snaps shut on its own sometimes.

items.name: Exile's Ring
items.lore: Siabra silver, turned so the stone faces in. Fereinn's people will know what it means.

items.name: Courier's Satchel-Belt
items.lore: It carried plans for a war. Now it carries your lunch.

items.name: Reeve's Seal Pendant
items.lore: Cathbad's own seal, the barley sheaf. 'Show it at any granary in Hibernia.'

items.name: Cruiach-Hide Cloak
items.lore: Alastriona's stolen hide, won back from Hughar. She says you've earned it more than she has.

items.name: Poacher's Ledger-Charm
items.lore: The ledger's brass clasp. Every sack, every coin.

items.name: Hughar's Snare-Ring
items.lore: A loop of poacher's wire, twisted into a ring.

items.name: Seal-Stone Shard
items.lore: A chip of the barrow's cracked seal-stone. Cold, always.

items.name: Barrow-Bone Bracer
items.lore: Bound from the arm-bones of a skeletal pawn. They've stopped moving. Mostly.

items.name: Red-Wax Candle Charm
items.lore: A stub of red wax, stamped with a hand. It won't light. You've tried.

items.name: Grey Wood Mantle
items.lore: Woven from the grey moss of the haunted wood. It keeps the mist off - and some of the cold.

items.name: Hayrick Belt
items.lore: The farmhand who hid the saddlebag gave you this, and wouldn't look at you.

items.name: Dergal's Runed Mantle
items.lore: Stitched from Dergal's vest. The runes still smoulder faintly - binding, and unbinding.

items.name: Pit-Chain Bracer
items.lore: A link of the chain that held Riona. She wanted it gone. You wanted it kept.

items.name: Riona's Vengeance Ring
items.lore: Riona wore it in the pit, hidden in her mouth. She says it kept her sane.

items.name: Summoner's Signet
items.lore: A red hand on lake-blue enamel: the seal of Clan Derg. The hand has been chiselled off.

items.name: Barrow-Song Pendant
items.lore: The Summoner's last note, caught in a bead of grey glass.

items.name: Gravewarden's Girdle
items.lore: The barrow's old guardians wore these. One of them gave it back.

items.name: War-Stone Pendant
items.lore: An uncut stone from the lake bed, the warlord's name scratched out.

items.name: Lorewoman's Ogham Bracer
items.lore: Cara carved it with the old names of the lake, before it was red.

items.name: Muster-Roll Satchel Belt
items.lore: It held the war camp's muster roll. You've kept the satchel.

items.name: Palisade-Stake Bracer
items.lore: Cut from the war camp's palisade, the night you slipped through it.

items.name: Roane-Watcher's Cloak
items.lore: Grey as a seal's back. The roane gave it to those who watch for them.

items.name: Quartermaster's Sash
items.lore: Every pocket held a red-hand coin. Lir had them melted for the widows' fund.

items.name: Outpost-Fire Ring
items.lore: Snatched out of the fire with the orders. It's still warm.

items.name: Mag Mell Guard Bracer
items.lore: Captain Lir's own issue. 'You've earned the green.'

items.name: Roane-Song Pearl
items.lore: The last captive sang into it as she went into the water. You can still hear it, very faintly.

items.name: Pen-Key Ring
items.lore: The key to the roane pens, bent into a ring. Nobody will use it again.

items.name: Slavemaster's Bane
items.lore: Cuan's whip-handle, broken in two and bound with sealskin.

items.name: Red Lake Mantle
items.lore: Lake-blue, with a red hand torn from it. Worn by those who broke the warlord's hold.
